tools.description: Find California schools four ways, whichever fits the question: free text over school/city/district names (`query`), inside a zip code (`zip`), within a radius of a place or coordinate (`near`), or the top-ranked schools at one level (`level` alone). Returns band, Scope Score, archetype and profile

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_schools · Private data: find_schools, compare_schools, my_watchlist, track_application · Public sink: district_profile, similar_schools · Destructive: find_schools.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_schools · Private data: find_schools, compare_schools, my_watchlist, track_application · Public sink: district_profile, similar_schools · Destructive: find_schools

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "compare_schools" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Compare 2-4 public schools side by side: band, Scope Score, exceeded/met split, cohort growth (aggregate school-by-grade cohorts across the grade span, as a 0-100 index centred on the state average), climate. A school with no cohort comparison reports no growth figure rather than a substitute — trea" → after: "Compare 2-4 public schools side by side: band, Scope Score and percentile, exceeded/met split, cohort growth (aggregate school-by-grade cohorts across the grade span, as a 0-100 index centred on the state average), and CDE's reported chronic absenteeism and suspension rates, each labelled with its y"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
